limitations: Archive-window/rating-quota convenience sample; not representative of the whole blitz population.
Only recorded fragment bytes are verified; no whole-archive checksum or publisher signature is claimed.
Provisional-rating status is unavailable; recorded ratings do not establish stable playing strength.
Engine observations are retained, not regenerated by dataset reconstruction.
Existing development/test exposure prevents new confirmation claims.

context.measure: immediate forced win versus automatic draw
context.expiry: every nonmating ordinary move terminates as draw
context.counterfactual: Same board and legal action with reversible counter 148; live does not assert a win.
context.optionalOwnDrawClaim: May be declined; choosing a valid claim draws instead.
context.ongoingRootAssumption: Conditional on the supplied root being ongoing; incomplete prior history cannot exclude earlier adjudication or unrecorded automatic repetition.
